en.text:
Weapon Kills instantly <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine and grant one stack of 'String of Curses' for 5.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

String of Curses Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• Increased Super Energy per kill: 0.8%|1.1%|1.4%|1.7%|2% 
• Increased damage (PvE): 20%|40%|60%|80%|100%
• Increased damage (PvP): 10%|20%|30%|40%|50%

Scoring three kills within 7.5 seconds of each other triggers a Cursed Explosion at the enemy's location, dealing <pve 305 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a ? meter radius. Kills must be achived without performing a manual reload or stowing the gun.

Cursed Explosion kills count towards triggering the next explosion and benefit from String of Curses.
